description: This file defines Swagger API response models for client transaction endpoints in the Fineract project. It contains nested static classes that represent various response schemas for client transactions, including list responses, transaction detail responses, and creation responses.

classes.name: ClientTransactionsApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: A container for nested classes representing Swagger response schemas related to client transactions.

classes.name: GetClientsClientIdTransactionsResponse
classes.description: Represents the response schema for listing transactions of a specific client.

classes.name: GetClientsPageItems
classes.description: Represents individual transaction items in the list response.

classes.name: GetClientsClientIdTransactionsType
classes.description: Schema for transaction type information, including id, code, and description.

classes.name: GetClientTransactionsCurrency
classes.description: Schema for transaction currency details such as code, name, symbol, etc.

classes.name: GetClientsClientIdTransactionsTransactionIdResponse
classes.description: Response schema for details of a specific transaction by ID.

classes.name: PostClientsClientIdTransactionsTransactionIdResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response after posting a new transaction.
